1.40 Recover exact C2PA auxiliary payloads

Symptom. A locally registered preview and cached settings can coexist with pending auxiliary downloads. Inspect the actual auxiliary type; content-authenticity payloads are distinct from editing masks.

Method. The optional BigTable extraction recipe uses an isolated APFS copy of closed Classic storage, raw-byte read-only access, and exact requested digest/SHA/size checks. It exports payloads without changing Cloud’s catalog or cache. The recipe includes prerequisites, verification and undo.

Evidence and limits. One qualified recovery exported 86 exact C2PA payloads and separately verified no-overwrite cache placement with settings bodies and revisions preserved. Native auxiliary adoption remained pending. This does not prove signature validity, offline editing or Sync completion. The public tool has synthetic extraction/APFS guard tests; native publication remains a separate step.

Status examples include qualified observations through 2026-10-21, not a claim that the entire catalog/cloud recovery is complete. Read the README for the current public implementation and release limits.
